title: 1cent Web Intelligence for AI Agents

toolsPreview.name: catalog.tools.search
toolsPreview.description: Start here before choosing a paid operation. Search the local 1cent catalog without fetching a URL or requiring payment. Returns up to five matching tools with purpose, current atomic Base USDC price and REST path.

toolsPreview.name: demo.url.pulse
toolsPreview.description: Return a precomputed example of 1cent URL Pulse output without payment, database access or any network request. This fixed demonstration never accepts a URL and never fetches an external resource.

toolsPreview.name: demo.live.pulse
toolsPreview.description: Run the real SSRF-protected URL Pulse service against the fixed https://example.com/ target without payment. The tool accepts no URL, is rate-limited per client and preserves normal cache and audit behavior.

toolsPreview.name: web.url.pulse
toolsPreview.description: Check a public HTTP or HTTPS URL before expensive browsing or AI processing. Returns availability, redirects, content type, page metadata, language, cache state, content hash, robots policy, and access restrictions. Does not execute JavaScript. Pass url as an absolute public HTTP(S) URL. Keep fresh=false to reuse cache; set fresh=true only when a new upstream fetch is required.

toolsPreview.name: web.url.passport
toolsPreview.description: Inspect a public HTTP or HTTPS URL and return a structured site passport. Includes pulse fields, registrable domain, robots and sitemap discovery, feeds, OpenAPI hints, and page metadata. Uses at most eight external HTTP requests and does not execute JavaScript. Pass url as an absolute public HTTP(S) URL. Keep fresh=false to reuse cache; set fresh=true only when a new upstream fetch is required.

toolsPreview.name: web.url.extract
toolsPreview.description: Extract normalized main text and optional links from a public HTTP or HTTPS document. Returns title, author, publication time, language, content hash, truncation and cache state. Output size and fetch time are bounded; JavaScript is not executed. Pass url as an absolute public HTTP(S) URL. Set include_links=true only when normalized links are needed. Keep fresh=false to reuse cache.

toolsPreview.name: web.url.changed
toolsPreview.description: Compare a public HTTP or HTTPS URL with its previously stored normalized content hash. Creates a baseline on first use, then reports whether content changed and returns current and previous hashes with timestamps. JavaScript is not executed. Pass url as an absolute public HTTP(S) URL. Keep fresh=false to reuse cache; set fresh=true only for a new fetch.

toolsPreview.name: web.batch.url_status
toolsPreview.description: Check HTTP status for one to five distinct public URLs. Quote equals the current per-URL unit price multiplied by URL count before work. Processing is sequential, bounded and preserves input order; partial failures use safe error codes.
